text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—It happened while I was having
an idle chat with Inari One...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Seems I just can't tell a lie to save my life.
Even when I think I'm pulling it off, I get found out right away.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, there's hardly ever a time where ya gotta lie.
I'm an Edokko born and bred; fibbin' ain't—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, please help me~...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
W-What's all this, then?
What's the matter, Creek?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, I'm kind of being chased right now~...
Could you hide me for a bit?
My pursuers are almost here~...!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Something feels off about this,
or rather, I don't really get what's going on.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, I know you're not a bad guy.
We gotta help each other out in times of need, right!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I had Super Creek quickly take
shelter in a locker, and—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Pardon the intrusion, Inari-senpai!
I've got urgent business!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yo, what's up, Bamboo?
What's got you in such a huge rush?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm chasing Creek-senpai!
Right now, she's wanted academy-wide
for the crime of 'Indiscriminate Pampering'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Wh-What?! That punk...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Still, turning him over just like that'd make me a liar.
As a true child of Edo, even if it takes a lie, I gotta protect... Huh?)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
They should've run off in this direction,
though... Did you see them, Inari-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ngh!? Y-Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you saw it!?
Right here!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: N-No, you're wrong! That just now was... uh...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Ohh. I haven't got the foggiest clue, see.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Is that so... If Inari-senpai says so, there's no doubt about it. Wait, but could she be hiding without senpai noticing...?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Is that right? Then search to your heart's content!
Anywhere besides the lockers
is totally fair game!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Locker? Is there something in the locker?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
N-No! How do I put this...!
Right now, that locker's haunted by a terrifying monster...
Yeah, a mummy has taken up residence inside it!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Argh, what kind of senior lies to her cute junior!
What in the world am I doing! But my promise to Creek...
Dammit all~!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, despite a clumsy lie, I managed to dodge
Bamboo Memory's grilling, and just as the
investigation was about to conclude—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Satisfied now, Bamboo?
Phew... That was more tiring than running...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your help, Inari-senpai!
Well then, excuse m—huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lying right where Bamboo Memory was looking...
was a baby rattle that seemed to have been
dropped by Super Creek!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Is this rattle...!?
One of Creek-senpai's seven secret tools...?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
N-No, you're wrong! That doesn't
belong to Creek!
That's... that's...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: It's mine!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Actually, I've been pretty beat lately, so I guess I wanted some comfort, or soothing... or somethin'...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Is that true!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"If you're tired, please tell me!!
I'll look after you and help you recharge anytime!!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah, jeez! Why'd you have to show up?!
It's all over!!
I knew I wasn't cut out for lying~~!!
choice_data_list: If you had built up more momentum, you might have pulled it off.
If you just don't give up till the very end, you'll manage somehow...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Get outta here, you want me to lie even more?!
No way I can do that!
My true feelings just slip out, see.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: And that's why your true feelings slipped out and you said you "need some pampering," right~? There, there.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
T-That's not it!
Ah, crap! I am so done with being lied to!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, Super Creek was dragged away,
all while casting a suspiciously covetous glance
at Inari One."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Even if you say that, what am I supposed to do? You'd have to be a master of deception to pull that off!
choice_data_list: Maybe we should practice lying instead?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
!! That's the crime of "False Training Preparation"!
...Between this and that lie from earlier, as a member of the Disciplinary Committee, I can't let this slide!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, Inari-senpai... I'm really sorry to do this, but at least let me be the one to arrest you, ssui!
Everyone, you're all under arreeeest!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, the three of them were all arrested together
and hauled away."
